title: ABBATelemetryAndFeedbackPipeline
feedbackLoopInvariants: ABBA is the master intelligence and feedback sink for governed ecosystem observations.
Telemetry is not automatically canonical truth, evidence, Pulse, Value, authority, permission, or ownership.
Signals must carry attributable source identity, provenance, timestamp, and integrity evidence appropriate to their source.
Unvalidated or contradictory signals are retained as anomalies or provisional observations rather than silently promoted to truth.
ABBA may synthesize signals and propose rebalancing, workflow, Team, or policy changes; consequential execution remains separately authority- and policy-gated.
Sensitive telemetry is minimized and access-scoped; full ecosystem read access is subject to data classification and policy rather than assumed universal visibility.
Feedback processing must not rewrite historical events or manufacture authority.
Recomposition preserves correlation, causation, provenance, and authorization lineage.

proposalRules.durableProposalStore: ABBA team proposals are persisted separately from canonical state events
proposalRules.idempotency: proposal writes use an idempotency key derived from source signal and objective
proposalRules.authorization: authorization_required is always true until an independent authority/policy gate records approval
proposalRules.executionBoundary: proposal persistence never executes the proposed Team or workflow

curationEngine.teamSelectionRule: suitability + availability + reliability + cost + latency + risk/context fit; output is a proposal, not authorization
